# Run Migrations Offline

This feature allows migrations to be executed in an offline mode by using a database URL defined in the configuration. It runs all migration scripts with literal SQL statements, which can be particularly useful for environments where database connections can't be established directly during the execution.

**Anchored to:**

- `alembic/env.py` — `alembic.env.run_migrations_offline`
